title: Spark e2e gate manifest
description: e2e/gate.yaml: the release-gate suite. Paths in include, budgets and coverage.checks are relative to e2e/; build, signoffs and report paths are relative to the repository root. See docs/e2e-flows.md#release-gate.

artifact.description: The release build to test, relative to the repository root. ${ARCH} becomes the target's arch (arm64 or x64).

sizeBudgetMB.description: The bundle audit's size budget for the artifact, in MB (10^6 bytes).

symbols.description: The folder of the build's debug symbols (dSYMs), relative to the repository root. ${ARCH} becomes the target's arch.

package.description: The spark package output the package audit checks: the distribution ZIP, or the folder holding the one <name>-<version>-<arch>.zip (with its dSYMs archive and updates/ feed), relative to the repository root. ${ARCH} becomes the target's arch.

sandbox.description: The App Sandbox variant of the release build (spark build --sandbox), which `variant: sandbox` flows test, relative to the repository root. ${ARCH} becomes the target's arch (docs/app-sandbox.md).

sandboxFlows.description: Globs of direct-build gate flows, relative to e2e/, that must also pass against `sandbox`. Their runs there have the IDs sandbox/<run ID> (docs/app-sandbox.md#testing).

machine.description: A reference machine from the budgets file: this target runs on that hardware and checks its budgets.

include.description: Globs of gate flows, such as flows/**.

tags.description: A flow with one of these tags blocks the release when it fails.

default.description: Whether every other flow blocks too. A flow listing a check registered `blocking: true` always blocks.

retries.description: Flaky = failed: the gate never retries.

timeBudget.description: The longest the whole gate run may take; flows still running then fail.

budgets.description: The performance budgets file (per reference machine).

signoffs.description: Manual sign-offs for this build (see docs/e2e-flows.md#manual-sign-offs).
